question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions at speeds of 60 km/h and 50 km/h. The length of one train is 430 m. The time taken by them to cross each other is 44 seconds. The length (in m ) of the other train, correct to 2 decimal places, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (opposite directions) = 60 + 50 = 110 km/h = 110 × 5/18 = 275/9 m/s

Total distance covered = Relative speed × Time = (275/9) × 44 = 12100/9 ≈ 1344.44 m

Length of second train = Total distance − Length of first train

Length of second train = 1344.44 − 430 = 914.44 m

**∴ The correct answer is 914.44 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = 60 km/h

Speed of Train 2 (S₂) = 50 km/h

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 430 m

Time to cross each other = 44 seconds

**Formula Used:**

When two objects move in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂

Total Distance = Speed × Time

When two trains cross each other, Total Distance = Sum of the lengths of the two trains.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 60 + 50 = 110 km/h

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 110 × (5/18) = 275/9 m/s

⇒ Total Distance = Length of Train 1 + Length of Train 2 = 430 + L₂

⇒ 430 + L₂ = Relative Speed × Time

⇒ 430 + L₂ = (275/9) × 44

⇒ 430 + L₂ = 12100 / 9

⇒ 430 + L₂ = 1344.44 m

⇒ L₂ = 1344.44 − 430

⇒ L₂ = 914.44 m

**∴ The correct answer is 914.44 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies are moving in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Crossing a Pole or Point Object

When a train crosses a stationary pole or a standing man, the distance covered is exactly equal to the length of the train itself.

Speed Conversion

To convert a value from km/h to m/s, multiply it by 5/18. To convert from m/s back to km/h, multiply by 18/5.
